notes:
Original and replication statistics are separately printed author-derived r values from the primary authors’ Table S1; no metric conversion performed here. Table S2 p. 20 identifies the target contrasts. Supplied replication page locator (p. 3 or p. 5) does not contain the target statistics in this supplement. No authors’ narrative verdict located; the Table S1 categorical Replicated entry is No. Original manuscript title verified, dated September 20, 2013. The target efficiency comparison is discussed on p. 27 using Tables 7 and 12 (p=.01); session counts established from Tables 2 and 11. Manuscript prints arm efficiency means 0.43 and 0.27, but no mean difference was calculated here.
